header.title: Registration Form Builder
header.description: Add, remove, and reorder fields in the user registration form. Changes are saved automatically.
header.exportHint: Download the saved form as a template zip — includes all fields and restrictions, plus every image and media link
header.printHint: Open a learner-view preview of the whole form, ready to save as PDF

exportDirtyConfirm: You have unsaved changes. The export contains the last SAVED version — export anyway?

toast.exported: Template exported — images and links are in the zip
toast.exportFailed: Could not export the form. Please try again.

confirmRemove: Remove this field from the registration form?

numeric.title: Numerical settings
numeric.hint: Values outside the range are still saved but flagged red to the learner and admin after they submit.

versions.pageBlurb: Every save is a dated version with a change description. Pin projects to the version they should use — unpinned projects follow the default.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history
versions.noDistricts: No projects pinned — unpinned projects use the default version
versions.assignBlurb: Learners in the ticked projects will see THIS version of the form. Unticked projects keep following the default version.
versions.noDistrictsExist: No projects exist yet — create one under Districts first.
versions.districtsSaveFailed: Could not save the project assignment. Please try again.
versions.defaultSaveFailed: Could not change the default version. Please try again.
versions.deleteHint: Delete this version from the history
versions.deleteBlurb: This removes the version from the history permanently. The default version and the last remaining version cannot be deleted.
versions.deleteUnpinTitle: Pinned projects will move to the default
versions.deleteUnpinBody: {{projects}} currently use this version and will fall back to the form's default version.
versions.deleteResponses: {{count}} submitted assessment was filled against this version. Its stored answers are unaffected — every response keeps its own snapshot.
versions.deleteResponses_other: {{count}} submitted assessments were filled against this version. Their stored answers are unaffected — every response keeps its own snapshot.
versions.deletedWithUnpinned: Version {{n}} deleted — {{projects}} now use the default version
versions.deleteFailed: Could not delete this version. Please try again.

saveVersion.title: Save as a new version
saveVersion.blurb: Like a commit: record when this change was made and what changed. The version history keeps every save.
saveVersion.dateFuture: The version date cannot be in the future.
saveVersion.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. First creation · Added Ranchi and Khunti to the district list
saveVersion.descriptionRequired: Describe the change — it identifies this version in the history.
saveVersion.makeDefaultHint: Learners in projects without a pinned version see the default. Untick to save a version only for specific projects.
saveVersion.saved: Saved as version {{n}} (pin projects to publish it)
saveVersion.detectedNone: No structural changes detected — only the description will be recorded.
saveVersion.savedDefault: Saved — version {{n}} is now the default for learners
saveVersion.saveFailed: Could not save the form. Please try again.
